project.name: exotic-compact-objects
project.description: Scientific research workspace for astrophysics: exotic compact objects, gravitational waves, quantum gravity, and observational catalogs. Produces a portfolio of theory documents, interactive notebooks, dashboards, catalogs, and a published site. | Flagship research project: black holes, wormholes, and white holes — symbolic derived physics models, a GWTC/HEASARC/BlackCAT observational data pipeline, 24 analysis notebooks, premium theory documents, and dashboards. A separate git repo subdomain of astro-science.

nodes.name: theory_black_holes.md
nodes.summary: Complete self-contained derivation of black hole theory from first principles: Schwarzschild solution via Birkhoff assumptions, full LaTeX field-equation chain with explicit SI units and (-,+,+,+) signature.

nodes.name: theory_kerr_newman.md
nodes.summary: Kerr-Newman rotating charged black hole: Einstein-Maxwell action and the full Boyer-Lindquist metric with mass M, spin a, charge Q parameters.

nodes.name: theory_kerr_newman_adm.md
nodes.summary: ADM decomposition of GR (lapse/shift) and a complete derivation of the ADM mass, angular momentum, and charge for Kerr-Newman spacetimes.

nodes.name: theory_reissner_nordstrom.md
nodes.summary: Reissner-Nordstrom static charged black hole: Einstein-Maxwell action, coupled field equations, and electromagnetic stress-energy derivation.

nodes.name: theory_christoffel_kerr.md
nodes.summary: Complete derivation of all 48 non-zero Christoffel symbols of the Kerr metric in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates, computed via the inverse metric and its derivatives.

nodes.name: theory_geodesic_equations.md
nodes.summary: Geodesic equations for Schwarzschild and Kerr: Lagrangian derivation, Hamilton-Jacobi separability, Carter constant, effective potentials, orbit classification, and pericenter advance.

nodes.name: theory_raychaudhuri.md
nodes.summary: Raychaudhuri equation for null and timelike congruences derived from geodesic deviation; expansion/shear/vorticity terms, focusing theorem, and Penrose-Hawking singularity theorem connections.

nodes.name: theory_fisher_matrix.md
nodes.summary: Fisher information matrix for gravitational-wave parameter estimation: waveform derivatives w.r.t. masses/spins, SNR inner-product integrals, covariance matrix, and BH-binary degeneracy analysis.

nodes.name: theory_bh_perturbation.md
nodes.summary: Black hole perturbation theory: linearized fluctuations over Schwarzschild/Kerr backgrounds separating into decoupled master equations, with the full metric setup in LaTeX.

nodes.name: theory_white_holes.md
nodes.summary: White hole complete theoretical treatment: time-reversed Schwarzschild interpretation, the deceptive metric invariance under time reversal, maximal-extension causal structure, and observational signatures.

nodes.name: theory_wormholes.md
nodes.summary: Wormhole theory derivation: historical Einstein-Rosen bridge (1935) through Morris-Thorne traversable metrics, all in LaTeX with derivations.

nodes.name: early_smbh_growth.md
nodes.summary: Early supermassive black-hole growth: evidence ledger for high-z quasars and JWST AGN (J0313-1806, CEERS 1019, GN-z11, UHZ1), Eddington-limited growth algebra, seed feasibility, and explicit caveats that the selection is not a complete or statistically representative sample.

nodes.name: quantum_gravity.md
nodes.summary: Quantum gravity module: why GR and QFT conflict, Planck-scale dimensional derivation, gravitational EFT as controlled low-energy theory below its cutoff, candidate UV approaches (string theory, LQG, asymptotic safety, causal sets), with strict measured/derived/illustration evidence labels.

nodes.summary: Compact complete theory in LaTeX: GR foundations (metric, Christoffel, Riemann, Ricci, Einstein equations) followed by the Schwarzschild solution and companion solutions.

nodes.name: derivations_report.md
nodes.summary: Auto-generated verification report: every symbolic derivation from models/derivations.py executed with SymPy (each check reduces to an identity or strict inequality), plus astropy/scipy numeric spot checks; one PASS entry per derivation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init: re-exports the equations symbols so users can import from the models package directly.

nodes.name: equations.py
nodes.summary: Core astropy-unit equations for exotic compact objects: Schwarzschild radius, Hawking temperature, ISCO and photon-sphere radii, Kerr horizon/ergosphere, Morris-Thorne wormhole shape/redshift/metric components, and white-hole constructions.

nodes.name: formulas.py
nodes.summary: Extended numeric formulas with astropy units: exact Kerr ISCO, ISCO orbital frequency, Eddington luminosity and accretion rate, and GW chirp mass / symmetric mass ratio / delta — each function cites the symbolic derivation that backs it.

nodes.name: derivations.py
nodes.summary: Fully symbolic Sympy derivations backing every formula in the project: Christoffel symbols, Ricci tensor, photon sphere, ISCO, Hawking radiation, wormhole flare-out; each derivation carries explicit checks and entry point run_all() yields DerivationResult dicts consumed by scripts/verify_formulas.py.

nodes.name: schwarzschild_radius
nodes.summary: Computes Rs = 2GM/c^2 in kilometers with astropy constants.

nodes.name: hawking_temperature
nodes.summary: Computes T_H = hbar c^3 / (8 pi G M kB) for a black hole.

nodes.name: morris_thorne_metric_components
nodes.summary: Returns (g_tt, g_rr) for the Morris-Thorne demo wormhole metric from shape and redshift functions.

nodes.name: kerr_isco_radius
nodes.summary: Exact Kerr ISCO radius via the Bardeen-Press-Teukolsky 1972 Z1/Z2 formula, prograde or retrograde.

nodes.name: eddington_luminosity
nodes.summary: Computes the Eddington luminosity limit 4 pi G M m_p c / sigma_T.

nodes.name: gw_chirp_mass
nodes.summary: Recomputes the chirp mass (m1 m2)^(3/5)/(m1+m2)^(1/5) used to cross-check GWTC catalog values.

nodes.name: run_all
nodes.summary: Entry point returning the full list of symbolic derivation results with formula, steps, and pass/fail checks; consumed by verify_formulas.py.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what the astro-science workspace is: a scientific research portfolio for exotic compact objects, gravitational waves, quantum gravity, and observational catalogs (not a web app). Then read CONTEXT.md, the single source of truth for every future session — repository layout, research projects, data sources, and conventions.

tour.title: Environment & Tooling
tour.description: SETUP_GUIDE and TOOLS_LIST inventory the Python 3.14 venv, astropy circles, and analysis tooling; requirements.txt pins the versions. check-environment.sh drives the checker module to verify the environment at a glance.

tour.title: Workspace History & Reports
tour.description: The installation summary, new-tools summary, and final report document how the workspace was assembled and what specialized tooling was added; SPECIALIZED_TOOLS.md details the analysis instruments available to research agents.

tour.title: Research Loop Automation
tour.description: Three loops power the portfolio: refresh-data.sh (download → process → rebuild dashboards), notebook-health.sh (execute all notebooks → fix → report), and research-loop.sh (hypothesis → derivation → figure → report → theory doc), coordinated by orchestrator.sh. The .opencode/loops README explains triggers, and the agent definitions (data engineer, validator, theoretician, reviewer) divide the work.

tour.title: Skills & Commands
tour.description: OpenCode skills encode workspace knowledge: astro-science (paths & projects), astro-loops (loop triggering), and astro-graphs (the three knowledge graphs). Commands expose the loops as /astro-* entries.

tour.title: Data Acquisition
tour.description: The download scripts fetch sample data into data/: direct archives and sample datasets; data/README documents the layout of what was pulled.

tour.title: Sample Observables: Catalogs, CMB & Fits
tour.description: Sample astronomical data products used for quick exploratory notebooks: galaxy and star catalogs (FITS), a synthetic CMB map and power spectrum, a large synthetic galaxy field, gravitational-wave strain and n-body snapshots, and an X-ray spectrum. Untitled.ipynb is a leftover exploratory scratch notebook.

tour.title: black-holes: GWOSC Snapshot Project
tour.description: A focused catalog project: update_gwosc.py refreshes the GWOSC/GWTC snapshot into data/black_holes.sqlite; update_heasarc_candidates.py pulls HEASARC candidate flags. reports/latest.md records the most recent refresh.

tour.title: black-holes-wormholes: Pedagogical Notebooks
tour.description: Fundamentals-first notebooks: 01_black_hole_fundamentals.ipynb walks through Schwarzschild horizons and causal structure; 02_geodesics_orbits.ipynb derives geodesic motion and orbit stability — the teaching layer under the research projects.

tour.title: The Karpathy-Pattern Wiki
tour.description: research/wiki/ holds 17 hand-written reference pages (Schwarzschild, Kerr, Kerr-Newman, Reissner-Nordström, geodesics, Raychaudhuri, Fisher matrix, Hawking radiation, wormholes, white holes, quantum gravity, GW catalogs…), dense with 144 wikilinks — the conceptual backbone that the wiki knowledge graph will map.

tour.title: Graphs & Graph Configuration
tour.description: Close the loop: docs/GRAPHS.md specifies the three-graph architecture (code graph, domain flows, wiki knowledge graph) and the subdomain merge strategy for the nested exotic-compact-objects repo; docs/AUTOMATION.md explains the loop scheduling that keeps data and graphs fresh. .ua/config.json stores graph output settings.

tour.title: Core Physics Models
tour.description: models/equations.py provides the astropy-unit closed forms (Schwarzschild radius, Hawking temperature, Morris-Thorne metric); formulas.py extends with exact Kerr ISCO and Eddington limits; derivations.py derives everything symbolically in SymPy with explicit checks.

tour.title: Theory Library
tour.description: The premium theory set derives each spacetime family completely: theory_black_holes (Schwarzschild from first principles), Kerr-Newman and ADM masses, Reissner-Nordstrom, the 48 Christoffel symbols, geodesics with Carter constant, and the Raychaudhuri equation.

tour.title: Data Refresh Pipeline
tour.description: Scripts rebuild the observational snapshot: update_gwosc_gwtc5.py refreshes the full GWTC-1..GWTC-5 catalog (391 events), download_heasarc.py and download_blackcat.py pull REM/CV catalogs, and process_blackcat.py + add_bh_derived_quantities.py produce the processed CSVs.

tour.title: Compute & Verify With Data
tour.description: compute_with_data.py reconciles the catalog (chirp-mass and redshift recomputation, mass-gap candidates) and quicklooks marquee-event strain; verify_formulas.py executes every symbolic derivation and numeric spot check, writing reports/derivations_report.md.

tour.title: Dashboards & Figures
tour.description: Dashboard builders turn processed CSVs into reproducible Plotly HTML: GWTC remnants, AGN reverberation masses, and BlackCAT dynamical masses (limits kept as limits); create_animations.py and make_premium_figures.py add the visual layer.

tour.title: Notebook Suite
tour.description: The 24 notebooks carry the analysis narrative: fundamentals (01), extended models (02), derivations with SymPy (05), complete theory (10), then fast scientific-profile notebooks (14-19) and catalog notebooks (20-24) backed by the processed data.

tour.title: Frontier Topics
tour.description: The frontier modules: 23_early_smbh_growth.ipynb with its premium companion quantify the feasibility of early SMBH seeds under Eddington-limited growth with explicit selection caveats; 24_quantum_gravity.ipynb and its companion separate measured fact, derived algebra, and illustration.
